typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblIntellimatchSnapshotGLCorporateBalancePool_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		balancepool as string,
		create_dt as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> corporatebalancepoolrecords
corporatebalancepoolrecords sink(input(
		Balancepool as string,
		Create_dt as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Balancepool = balancepool,
		Create_dt = create_dt),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblIntellimatchSnapshotGLCorporateBalancePool_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblIntellimatchSnapshotGLCorporateBalancePool
